I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It states that the project uses semantic versioning (major.minor.patch), and that the decision was recorded on 2026-09-23.

The only source for this was the project's decision memory, and I couldn't cross-check it against anything in the repo. A grep for versioning terms found nothing in the repo files.

Memory holds two versioning decisions from that day. The first adopted calendar versioning (calver), and a later one revised it to semver. I treated the later one as current. As you asked, the file doesn't mention the retired calver option.

I read only the first 1,889 of 2,667 lines of `docs/doc.md`, the Gin quick-start guide. Nothing in that part concerns versioning, and the grep found no versioning terms anywhere in the repo.
